text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while has passed since the Yayoi Sho, and summer camp season has come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka knows she must become faster, but she's plagued with concern because of how heavy and uncooperative her legs are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a disquieting start for this year's summer camp.
